evidence.api_compatibility: New optional fields source (install, dry-run) and backend_source (load) in API routes — existing requests and responses are unchanged. New config key backend_source with default github. is_reachable() gains optional accept_redirect parameter defaulting to false. No existing setup breaks on upgrade.
evidence.documentation: PR body provides comprehensive user-facing documentation covering config, CLI, API fields, and behavioral differences. Configuration docs updated in docs/guide/configuration/README.md. Note: CodeRabbit flagged missing checksums.modelscope entries for vLLM gfx942/gfx950 override assets — ModelScope installs for those GPUs will fail until the mirror is updated.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The feature is user-reachable through a new config key (backend_source), CLI flags (--source, --backend-source), and API fields (source, backend_source) on install, dry-run, and load. No evidence shows a human exercised the full mirror install → load → inference path on a release candidate. CI passes the backend-source flag through the API, but that is not a human exercising it.
evidence.post_approval_commits: @jeremyfowers added commit 75f43c3a (fix(backends): count a redirect as reachable for the download-service probe) at 2026-11-23T23:32:33Z, one minute before approving — renewed review covers this behavioral change. The PR was squashed and merged at 2026-11-24T04:13:40Z by @jeremyfowers.
evidence.review: @jeremyfowers (admin maintainer, subject area: new features) submitted the only substantive human review and approved at 2026-11-23T23:32:44Z. @Zorro-Zhang provided extensive review feedback across two comments covering security (empty expected_hash, token exposure, assets.json integrity after interrupted sync) and the PR body lists every feedback item addressed. CodeRabbit AI and GitHub Advanced Security both commented on minor issues.
evidence.security: ModelScope downloads are fail-closed — every mirrored file must match a SHA-256 pin in checksums.modelscope of backend_versions.json, or the download is refused. No token sent on public reads; redirect handler drops credentials on cross-host redirects. Zorro-Zhang raised token and hash concerns; both addressed. The mirror tooling's CodeQL issues (untrusted checkout, incomplete URL sanitization) are deferred to a follow-up PR.
evidence.tests: 29 C++ unit tests in BackendSourceTest covering URL construction, config/env/validation, per-request scope, worker thread hand-off via carry_to_worker, and fail-closed hash verification. 3 server endpoint integration tests in server_endpoints.py (dry-run URL selection, unknown source rejection with 400, live onnxruntime:cpu install from the mirror with hash verification). @itomek tested on Strix Halo Linux, verifying source rejection, request isolation, and checksum rejection.

maintainer_todos.text: Set backend_source=modelscope, install llamacpp:cpu (Linux/Windows) or llamacpp:metal (macOS) from the ModelScope mirror, then load a model and run a chat completion — confirm the backend installs from the mirror with hash verification and inference succeeds.
Run lemonade backends install llamacpp:vulkan --source modelscope — confirm the backend installs from the mirror.

subject: Add backend_source=modelscope to download backends from a ModelScope mirror (#4154)
summary: Adds backend_source=modelscope as a config option, per-request API field, and CLI flag to download pinned backend binaries from the public lemonade-sdk/backends ModelScope mirror instead of GitHub Releases and AMD's tarball server.
verdict_reason: A new user-facing download source with a broader code path was merged with maintainer review, but a live mirror install end-to-end on a release candidate should be verified before shipping.
